title: FeatureRegistry
description: Spec-ahead. Catalog of feature modules, plans and limits, bundled in the app so resolution works offline; the resolution order is defined in ADR 0008. Instance: registries/feature-modules.yaml. No code anchor yet; moves to schemas/ once implemented.

trialDays.description: Length of the one-time, no-card, user-started trial of each trialable module

entitlementKey.description: standard: every plan; automation: paid on-device module (Plus picks, all on Pro and Family); cloud: Pro and Family only

dependencies.description: Modules that must be enabled for this one to be enabled

costClass.description: onDevice: runs in the app with only standard Firestore storage; cloud: needs paid server compute (Blaze)

userHideable.description: The user may hide the module in settings

trialable.description: One trial per user of trialDays length

killSwitchable.description: Remote Config may switch the module off. false for modules that give users access to their own data (inventory viewing, export and delete), which are never switched off; such a module has no remoteConfigKey

remoteConfigKey.description: Remote Config boolean parameter: kill switch and rollout gate. Bundled default: true for standard modules; for automation and cloud modules false in production until the pre-paid-launch sign-off is recorded (ADR 0009), true in other environments. Required unless killSwitchable is false

revenueCatEntitlement.description: RevenueCat entitlement identifier that grants the plan; null for free

automationPicks.description: automation modules the user picks when automation is not granted in full

pickSwapCadence.description: How often picks may be swapped: at most one swap per month, whatever the billing period (calendar month vs rolling 30 days is an open question in ADR 0008). Required when automationPicks is above 0

inventories.description: Active (writable) inventories; null = unlimited. Paid plans are unlimited; a hidden fair-use limit against abuse is not modeled here (ADR 0008)

sharing.description: Sharing with people outside the user's household

inventories.description: Inventories the user may share; null = not limited

partners.description: People a shared inventory may be shared with; null = not limited

maxMembers.description: Household members including the subscriber; 1 = no household

minorsAllowed.description: An adult may invite members aged 13 to 17
